meta.name: workshop-facilitation
meta.description: Facilitate workshop sessions in a one-step, multi-turn flow. Use when an interactive skill needs consistent pacing, options, and progress tracking.

copy.tagline: 引导工作坊的互动流程，保持节奏与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要主持结构化的团队工作坊或会议
copy.tagline_en: Facilitate workshop sessions with consistent pacing and progress tracking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to host structured team workshops or meetings

howto.what: Claude 会一次只问一个问题，显示进度标签（如“背景 Q3/8”），在决策点给出编号选项，并支持多选、中断恢复和快速输出模式。
howto.when: 当你要求运行一个结构化工作坊或引导式会议，或调用其他交互技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我引导一个45分钟的回顾会，主题是失败的beta发布。
用引导协议跑一个产品定位工作坊。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤提问，并在决策点给出推荐选项。

howto.what_en: Claude asks one question per turn, shows progress labels (e.g., "Context Q3/8"), offers numbered options at decision points, and supports multi-select, interruption recovery, and fast-path output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run a structured workshop or guided session, or when another interactive skill invokes this protocol.

say_en.text: Facilitate a 45-min retro on our failed beta launch.
say_en.note: Claude will estimate time and question count, then ask for entry mode.

say_en.text: Run a product positioning workshop using this protocol.
say_en.note: Claude will step through questions and give recommendations at decision points.
